sources.note: A grammar sketch of Nsamban based on recent fieldwork; the abstract dwells on the vowel system (13 vowels incl. front rounded and added near-close vowels, final-vowel loss, diphthongization, umlaut). Oxford Guide sketches follow a fixed template whose phonology section includes tone, so a first-hand statement of the Nsamban tone inventory and tone marking is very likely on pp. 761-764; content unseen.
